storeId.description: Identity of the durable engine store this read answered from, stable across restarts. A lookup without a store identity is refused as unavailable instead of answering.

runId.description: Run bound to the job at this read; null while none is bound, or for a job that ended before a run.

state.description: The job's lifecycle state at this read.

runDir.description: Run artifact directory; null before a run.

taskId.description: Task id; null before it is allocated.

message.description: Recorded failure message; null when none was kept.

code.description: Recorded machine code; null for an untyped failure.

status.description: HTTP status the start route answers for this failure; null when none is recorded.

retryable.description: The recorded retryability; null when the producer made no claim.

requiredActions.description: Bounded actions recorded with the failure.

context.description: Bounded recorded context; store and task-group identity are not repeated here.

problem.description: The refusal or failure an accepted job records. A lookup returns it with HTTP 200; it is the job's outcome, not a failure of the read.

at.description: The deadline the engine enforces: the run's own or, when earlier, its Delegate parent's current one; after the terminal, the one it ended under.

revision.description: Revision of the run's own deadline; a set must name it.

serverNow.description: The server's wall clock when this answer was made.

state.description: Linear per run: armed while it is live and its deadline was neither reached nor claimed (the only state a set is accepted in); enforcing once its deadline won and the stop began; expired once the run's terminal followed its deadline; closed after any other terminal.

stopGraceSec.description: Seconds after `at` by which every process inside the run's boundary is gone (see the capability's `boundary`). Physical limits outside it: a suspended host stops the run when it wakes; a task in uninterruptible kernel I/O (D state) dies once that I/O returns; on the marker boundary a process running as another user, one that cleared its environment after leaving the recorded tree, or (once the run ended normally) one whose environment cannot be read outside that tree, is not found; work handed to another service (a container engine, an already running tmux server, systemd-run) is outside the boundary.

inheritedFrom.description: Job id of the Delegate parent (or further ancestor) whose deadline is the effective one, or null.

successorOf.description: Job id of the predecessor whose deadline this continuation took at acceptance (it had none of its own, or an earlier live one capped it), or null.

outcome.description: confirmed: the warden proved the run's boundary empty and left. unresolved: it stopped trying without that proof (an unclassifiable process, or a member that would not die); `detail` names why.

detail.description: Why membership could not be established; null when confirmed.

enforcement.description: The warden's final report on the run's processes; null while it has none.

deadline.description: The run-deadline/1 deadline the job holds, read without any transition from its durable record: one the request set, or, for a reader that sends X-Claudexor-Capabilities: 1, one it inherited (a continuation of a run with a deadline, a Delegate child of one, or a job its deadline ended).

handle.description: Durable handle of the job a start request created, read without waiting for it.

anyOf.description: The store retains the job this exact key and request created.

turnId.description: The turn this exact key and request recorded.

runId.description: Run bound to the turn; observe exactly this run. Null when no run is bound.

code.description: Machine-readable refusal code; remedies key on it, never on the message text.

retryable.description: False when no recorded job exists to replay — surfaces offer a new message instead of a doomed retry.

requiredActions.description: Bounded user actions that may make an exact retry succeed.

context.description: Bounded typed recovery context for exact retry.

enqueueError.description: Why this turn has no run (enqueue/preflight refusal); null once a run binds.

anyOf.description: The store retains the turn this exact key and request recorded, but no command bound to them: the enqueue failed or never happened, or retention removed the command. Nothing is enqueued for it.
This store's current partition retains no binding for this key and request. It never proves that the original request was not accepted and never authorizes a new start.

ControlStartLookupResponse.description: Read-only lookup of an accepted run or thread-turn start by its original request and Idempotency-Key.
